import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan,find_deficient_cut
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(303)
for n in [2,5,10,20,32]:
 for it in range(10):
  roots={i:random.randint(1,100) for i in range(n)};D=sum(roots.values())
  # path links; choose caps side max. Compute side sums
  pref=0;caps=[]
  for i in range(n-1):
   pref+=roots[i];caps.append(max(pref,D-pref))
  links=[(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)];env={i:caps[i] for i in range(n-1)};p=random.choice([1,2,5])
  t=time.time();out,pay=compile_plan(n,links,list(range(n)),roots,p,env);dt=time.time()-t
  assert out=='prepared',(out,pay)
  validate_plan(pay,n,links,list(range(n)),roots,p,env)
  if it==0:print('n',n,'D',D,'time',round(dt,3),'trees',len(pay['trees']),'routes',len(pay['routes']),'recipes',len(pay['recipes']))
print('path OK')
